_about: Ground heights round Epsom racecourse, metres above sea level, from the AWS Terrain Tiles (Mapzen terrarium, zoom 15; in Britain built from Environment Agency LIDAR and other open DEMs), sampled 18 Nov 2026 through the owner's built-in browser. Grid: east x and north y metres about lat 51.309, lon -0.253 (x = (lon+0.253)*111320*cos(51.309 deg), y = (lat-51.309)*110574). Rows run south to north (y0 upward), columns west to east.
